---
title: Home
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        # quarto-cli #14739 (bd-kwgtllvn): the navbar color-scheme toggle
        # is a localized switch button, not an `<a href="">`. The
        # color-mode runtime keeps `aria-checked` in sync; its behavior
        # is covered by the JSDOM tests in
        # ts-packages/preview-renderer/src/q2-preview/quarto-color-mode.integration.test.ts.
        #
        # Only the navbar markup is asserted here: this fixture also runs
        # in the hub-client preview (hub-client/e2e/smoke-all.spec.ts),
        # which does not inject the inline color-mode script, so its
        # `data-toggle-label` is checked by the native pipeline test
        # theme_light_dark::color_scheme_toggle_label_is_localized instead.
        - - '.quarto-navbar-tools > button.quarto-color-scheme-toggle[type="button"][role="switch"][aria-checked="false"][aria-label="Dunkelmodus umschalten"][title="Dunkelmodus umschalten"]'
        - - 'a.quarto-color-scheme-toggle'
---

A website page whose theme has a dark variant, so the navbar carries
the color-scheme toggle.
